image_description: A black and white photograph showing the interior of a dark, arched stone tunnel or corridor leading to a bright, barred gate. The walls are rough-hewn stone or brick, curving into an arch overhead. At the end of the tunnel is a tall, rectangular opening filled with a heavy metal grid or bars, topped by an arched window section also barred. Light streams in from outside, creating high contrast.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a prison/correctional facility interior rather than a generic dungeon, cellar, or historical fortification.
To verify the linear perspective of the tunnel converges correctly and the bar gate sits logically in the plane without warping or melting.
To ensure the individual bars of the gate are distinct, continuous entities and do not fuse with the background light or wall edges.
To check for subtle noise patterns, inconsistent lighting gradients, or texture smearing common in AI-generated monochrome images.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the metal bar grid (no bending/fusing)
Consistency of stone/brick texture on curved surfaces

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the metal bars with the bright background light; AI often fails to render thin, high-contrast linear structures cleanly, resulting in bleeding or broken segments.
